chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
When one of you has a deceased person, then lay him down facing the qiblah, and likewise, when he is washed, the place of washing should be dug for him facing the qiblah.

key_terms.الْقِبْلَةِ: the qiblah, the direction of prayer
key_terms.الْمُغْتَسَلِ: the washing place for the deceased
key_terms.فَسَجُّوهُ: then lay him down or place him

ai.seo_question: How should the deceased and the place of washing be positioned in relation to the qiblah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal instruction regarding the handling of the deceased in Shia funeral practice. It directs that the dead person be placed facing the qiblah and that the place prepared for washing the body also be oriented toward the qiblah, showing the continuing sanctity of qiblah even in death rites.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.591 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"When one of you dies, lay him down facing the Qibla, and likewise, when he is washed, let the place of washing be dug facing the Qibla."
